errata.error: SMHI's Göteborg-Eriksberg levels from 1 January to 12 November 2018 are Göteborg-Tingstadstunneln's, value for value.
errata.response: 1 January to 12 November 2018 at Eriksberg is flagged `suspect`, keeping SMHI's own flag as `source_flag`.
errata.evidence: Found by the cross-station checks in `scripts/cross-check.ts` ([#121](https://github.com/openwatersio/water-levels/pull/121)), November 2026. Eriksberg and Tingstadstunneln (`smhi/33093`), 6 km apart, usually differ by 2 cm RMS and 3 to 6 cm in mean level; over the span they are identical, mean included. Against Göteborg-Torshamnen (`smhi/2109`), Eriksberg sits about 1 cm low before and after but 3 to 7 cm high over the span, where Tingstadstunneln always is, so Eriksberg is the one holding the other's data. GESLA's SMHI copy carries the same values (erratum `gesla-eriksberg-2018-tingstadstunneln`); GESLA's CMEMS copy doesn't.
